<!-- Generated by apps/docs/scripts/generate-ui-reference.mjs. -->

Place Image and Fallback under the same Root so that the fallback can appear while the image is unavailable. Group and GroupCount compose stacked avatars.

## Usage

```ts
import { avatar, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/avatar';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/avatar`. It [registers](../../registration/) 6 components for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

<a id="shadcn-avatar-root"></a>

### `shadcn.Avatar.Root`

Native exports include `components.Root`, `components.Avatar`.

| Input | JSON type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `loadingStatus` | `"error" \| "loading" \| "loaded"` | Default `"loading"` |
| `size` | `"default" \| "sm" \| "lg"` | Default `"default"` |
| `aria-label` | `null \| string` |  |
| `class` | `string` |  |
| `delayMs` | `number` |  |
| `id` | `string` |  |
| `placeholder` | `null \| string` |  |
| `text` | `string` |  |

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Root>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.
